Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.
Ms. Tanya Kapoor, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
Shri T.S. Phartiyal, learned Addl. CSC for the 
State / respondents no. 2, 5 and 6.
Application for amendment (I.A. No. 1 of 
2023) is allowed being formal one. 
Let learned counsel for the petitioner amend 
the writ petition within seven days. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
Consumer Redressal Forum does not have 
jurisdiction in matter relating to SARFESI Act.
Issue rule nisi. 
Learned State Counsel has accepted notice on 
behalf of respondents no. 2, 5 and 6 and received 
copy of the brief. 
Issue notice to respondent no. 3 and 4 by 
registered post acknowledgment due, returnable 
within four weeks. 
Postal requisites be filed within seven days. 
Counter affidavit be filed within four weeks. 
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, be filed within two 
weeks, thereafter. 
List on 04.05.2023. 
In the meantime, effect and operation of the 
judgment dated 01.11.2022 passed by respondent no. 
1 shall remain stayed till the next date of listing. 
 (Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, J.)
 12.01.2023
(Grant urgent certified copy of this order, as per Rules)

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 3495 of 2022
Hon’bleRavindraMaithani, J.
Ms. Tanya Kapoor, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. V.S.Rawat, Brief Holder for the 
State.
Instant petition was dismissed for non 
prosecution on 04.05.2023.
Now restoration application has been 
filed on the ground that due to personal 
reasons learned counsel for the petitioner 
could not appear because his mother was 
unwell.
The Restoration application is 
delayed by six days. A Delay Condonation 
Application has also been filed. The reason 
for the delay is that the counsel for the 
petitioner could not attend the Court due to 
personal reasons.
Having considered, this court is of the 
view that the grounds for delay are 
sufficient. The delay condonation 
application is allowed. Delay in filing the
Restoration Application (MCC No. 02 of 
2023) is condoned.
Having considered, the restoration 
application is allowed. Order dated 04.05.2023 
is recalled. The petition is restored to its 
number.
List this case on 03.11.2023 for final 
hearing.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)
12.07.2023
Nahid
